metadata.title: बाबूलाल मरांडी जेब में आधार क्यों रखते हैं | Why Babulal Marandi shows Aadhar to Hemant Soren
metadata.description: In an exclusive interview with Main Bhi Bharat editor Chitrita Sanyal, Jharkhand BJP president Babulal Marandi expressed confidence that his party, along with NDA allies, would secure more than 22 out of 43 seats in the first phase of polling, paving the way to form the next state government. Marandi criticized Chief Minister Hemant Soren's government for its alleged failure to address illegal infiltration from Bangladesh, particularly in the Santhal Pargana region. He questioned why the state administration has not acted to identify and curb the influx of illegal migrants, asserting that the BJP is committed to safeguarding Jharkhand’s borders and culture.
